kept.name: Major League Baseball
kept.why: Mother Design created five bespoke typefaces for the league, giving slug a specific change to watch for in scores, headlines and team coverage.

kept.name: The Sainsbury Museum and Art Centre
kept.why: North Design drew the centre’s new geometric mark from Norman Foster’s original building plans.

kept.name: Programa
kept.why: Programa’s software redesign gives slug a reason to watch how it explains the less visible work of interior design, from tracking dimensions to tallying materials.

kept.name: Framery
kept.why: Framery pitches its office pods as a subscription, shifting the sales message from furnishing a room to avoiding waste when a company moves.

kept.name: Xinú
kept.why: The perfume brand’s angular black-timber displays in Tokyo offer a concrete point of comparison for how it presents scent online.

kept.name: cadillac
kept.why: The Las Vegas F1 livery borrows iridescent circuitry from translucent Y2K electronics, a visual reference to watch for in the brand’s digital work.

kept.name: Chipotle
kept.why: A hoodie with a concealed burrito pocket turns the chain’s sense of humor into a product and gives its campaign copy a clear hook.

kept.name: Tiffany & Co.
kept.why: The Nature Adorned exhibition traces a century of nature motifs in Tiffany jewelry, from an Arkansas diamond to orchid brooches.

kept.name: Klafs
kept.why: Retractable saunas and immersive ice rooms give Klafs two very different engineering stories to tell under one wellness brand.
